title: Thanks For Your Patience (Question Mark Icon)
style: lo-fi hip hop, jazzy chords, female mellow lead, male hype ad-libs, 82 BPM, vinyl crackle, mellow piano, finger snaps, melancholy, study-beats, customer-support-purgatory
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
We're receiving a lot more messages than usual
So there may be a delay before our team can do this
Thanks for your patience, if you need immediate help
Try searching our help center, ring the bell yourself

[Pre-Chorus]
Just click the question mark icon in the bottom right
Your answer might be hiding in plain sight

[Chorus]
Thanks for your patience, thanks for your patience
We'll get back to you as soon as we can, in stations
Thanks for your patience, thanks for your patience
Click the question mark, lower your expectations

[Verse 2]
The team can also help, but the team is delayed
The queue is a thousand, the agents are afraid
Messages stacking up like dishes in the sink
Thanks for your patience, that's all we can think

[Bridge]
Question mark, question mark, lower bottom right
Glowing little circle in the customer night
Click it, scroll it, search for your fate
FAQ articles dated from a previous date

[Outro]
Thanks for your patience, the loop is eternal
The question mark circles in the corner journal
